I’m so increasingly thankful for them all but they’re starting to get on my nerves. Since I’m studying to be a nurse, I can understand and break down medical jargon to my family in a way that they can understand. This is essentially what my whole family does. **I am not a medical professional!** I don’t feel comfortable with my family asking me to ok or veto potential treatments or operations, but they don’t listen when I tell them that though!
